desc: The easiest way to reduce felt recoil for hard-to-fit stocks, the Limb Saver Slip-On Recoil Pad provides the same shooting comfort as LimbSaver's precision fit pads. Simply slip the pad over the stock of most rifles, shotguns, and muzzleloaders for a recoil reduction of up to 50 percent. The recoil pad helps increase accuracy of follow-up shots and you'll enjoy increased control for maximum stability. Designed to slip over existing firearm stocks without any modifications, it will work with or without factory recoil pads.
